title: Adjust master volume using amixer
summary: Use the amixer command to increase or decrease the master audio volume by a specific percentage. This is useful for quick volume adjustments from the terminal.

steps.explain: Increase the master volume by a specified percentage (e.g., 10%).

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The percentage to increase the volume by, e.g., 10

alternatives.explain: Decrease the master volume by a specified percentage (e.g., 10%).

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The percentage to decrease the volume by, e.g., 10
